_comment: Hand-written retrieval evaluation: queries whose correct answer is known from the fixtures.
expected_entity_ids are the directory entities a correct answer must surface; a retrieved
chunk counts as relevant when its entity_id is in that list. Every entry below was checked
against fixtures/directory/*.json by hand — a query whose expected answer is wrong makes
every number computed from it meaningless.
Ids are fixture ids: providers 30000000-…-XXXX, hospitals 20000000-…-XXXX.
kind 'lexical' means the query shares vocabulary with the target chunk; 'paraphrase' means
it does not, which is what the vector arm (and the reranker) is supposed to earn.

queries.note: name plus the field entity chunking must keep attached to it
Ahmet Kilic consults in Turkish; his chunk says 'consults in Turkish (native)'

queries.query: cardiologist who is not accepting new patients
queries.note: Raymond Osei's panel is closed; the specialty filter must exclude Jonas Petersen
Jonas Petersen's subspecialty, indexed as its own atom

queries.query: wheelchair accessible dermatology clinic in Chicago
queries.note: Melanie Cross at Lakeview; filters must reach both arms for this to stay on target

queries.query: hospital that reviews every referral before offering a slot
queries.note: Ravenswood Specialty Surgical Center blurb, paraphrased

queries.query: address of the hospital on North Fairbanks Court
queries.note: either the hospital chunk or the location chunk is a correct source

queries.query: interventional cardiologist at the Naperville hospital
queries.note: Omar Haddad; the city filter is the discriminating constraint

queries.query: who speaks Spanish at Prairie Ridge Memorial Hospital
queries.note: Elena Marquez and Camila Restrepo, plus the hospital's own language statement

queries.query: hospital that can arrange a sign language interpreter
queries.note: Lakeview (Chicago) and Hudson Park (New York) both record that feature
